report: Address 0x2222222222222222222222222222222222222222 was examined for human behaviour. LONG_HISTORY: the first transaction of this address dates back to April 2023, with sustained activity across more than two years. DIVERSE_COUNTERPARTIES: the address has interacted with 214 distinct counterparties across decentralised exchanges, lending, NFT marketplaces and gaming contracts. UNIQUE_BEHAVIOUR: amounts, timing and contract choices vary widely from transaction to transaction, with manual-looking gaps and no cloned pattern shared with any other address. No sybil signal is present in this evidence: there is no shared funder, no identical transaction pattern, no burst activity and the history is not fresh.
title: Behaviour evidence report — established user
